jj.name: * Jessica Jones
jj.text: [star] Gather Evidence — Response: After you use a basic power, place 1 evidence counter on Alias Investigations.

jj.name: * Jessica Jones
jj.text: Incognito Mode — Action: Change to hero form. You cannot change back to alter-ego form this phase. Setup: Put the Alias Investigations support into play.

jj.name: * Alias Investigations
jj.text: Permanent. Response: After a side scheme is defeated, exhaust this card → place 2 evidence counters here. Then, you may remove evidence counters from here equal to the villain's remaining hit points to defeat the villain's current stage.

jj.name: * Luke Cage
jj.text: Toughness. Action: Exhaust Luke Cage and deal 1 damage to him → give him a tough status card.

jj.name: "Big Mistake"
jj.text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 3 damage to an enemy. You may remove 1 evidence counter from Alias Investigations to deal 2 additional damage and for this attack to gain either overkill or piercing.

jj.name: Breakthrough
jj.text: Response: After an evidence counter is placed on Alias Investigations, ready your identity. Shuffle this card into your deck.

jj.name: Snooping Around
jj.text: Alter-Ego Action (thwart): Remove 4 threat from a scheme and place 2 evidence counters on Alias Investigations. Discard the top card of the encounter deck. If that card is a minion or side scheme, reveal it.

jj.name: * Piecing It All Together
jj.text: This scheme does not count against the player side scheme limit. When Defeated: The defeating player draws 3 cards.

jj.name: Calling in Favors
jj.text: Alter-Ego Action: Remove 2 evidence counters from Alias Investigations and exhaust Calling in Favors → search your deck for an ally and play it as if it were in your hand, reducing its resource cost by 2. (Shuffle.)

jj.name: 4K Digital Camcorder
jj.text: Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust this card and choose a non-[[Elite]] minion. Remove X evidence counters from Alias Investigations, where X is equal to 2 less than that minion's remaining hit points → discard that minion.

jj.name: Circumstantial Evidence
jj.text: Response: After an enemy is defeated, exhaust Circumstantial Evidence → place 1 evidence counter on Alias Investigations.

jj.name: Leather Jacket
jj.text: Jessica Jones gets +2 DEF. Response: After you defend, place 1 evidence counter on Alias Investigations.

jj.name: "Now I'm Ticked Off!"
jj.text: Forced Response (attack): After the villain activates against a player, if you are in alter-ego form, change to hero form. Deal 5 damage to the villain and each minion engaged with that player. Discard this card.

jj.name: Reluctant Flier
jj.text: Hero Interrupt (defense): When you would take at least 3 damage from an attack, discard this card → prevent all of that attack's damage. Take 1 damage.

jj.name: Stakeout
jj.text: Action: If this card is in your play area, attach it to a non-permanent encounter side scheme. Interrupt: When a character thwarts attached scheme, that thwart removes 2 additional threat. If that thwart defeats attached scheme, place 2 evidence counters on Alias Investigations.

jj.name: * Captain Marvel
jj.subtitle: Carol Danvers
jj.text: Response: After Captain Marvel enters play, discard the top 4 cards of your deck. If you discard a printed [energy] resource, remove 2 threat from a scheme. If you discard more than one printed [energy] resource, also confuse an enemy.

jj.name: * Spider-Woman
jj.subtitle: Mattie Franklin
jj.text: Response: After a character you control thwarts, place 1 limb counter here (to a maximum of 8). You may discard Spider-Woman to deal 1 damage to an enemy for each limb counter here.

jj.name: * Squirrel Girl
jj.subtitle: Doreen Green
jj.text: Response: After you play Squirrel Girl from your hand, place 1 squirrel counter here for each card in your hand (to a maximum of 4). Action: Remove 1 squirrel counter from here → remove 1 threat from a scheme.

jj.name: Lay Down the Law
jj.text: Hero Response (thwart): After you change form, remove 3 threat from a scheme (4 threat instead if you paid for this card using a [mental] resource).

jj.name: Strategy Session
jj.text: Alter-Ego Action: Choose a player to search their deck for a player side scheme and add it to their hand. Hero Action (thwart): Remove 3 threat from a player side scheme.

jj.name: * Run Them to Ground
jj.text: Victory 0. When Defeated: Resolve each of the following: • Skip the next villain phase. • Deal each player 1 facedown encounter card (immediately). • The villain cannot take damage until the start of the next (unskipped) villain phase.

jj.name: * Lay the Trap
jj.text: Victory 0. When Defeated: The player who defeated this scheme deals 5[per_hero] damage to the villain.

jj.name: Determination
jj.text: Max 1 per deck. Hero Response: After you spend this card, remove 1 threat from the main scheme.

jj.name: Grapnel Launcher
jj.text: Restricted. Hero Action: Discard this card → make a basic thwart without exhausting (even if you are exhausted). For this thwart, your hero gets +1 THW and ignores the patrol keyword and any crisis icons ([crisis]) in play.

jj.name: Entrapment
jj.text: Max 1 per player. Alter-Ego Response (attack): After the villain schemes, change to hero form and discard this card → deal damage to the villain equal to the amount of threat placed by that activation.

jj.name: * Hellcat
jj.subtitle: Patsy Walker
jj.text: If your identity has the [[Defender]] trait, this card gains: "Action: Put Hellcat into play from your hand. At the end of the phase, discard her."

jj.name: Joys of Life
jj.text: Alliance. Action: Choose: • Exhaust a [[Civilian]] alter-ego → ready a hero or ally. • Exhaust a hero or ally → ready a [[Civilian]] alter-ego.

jj.name: Unbreakable Bond
jj.text: Team-Up (Jessica Jones and Luke Cage). Max 1 per deck. Hero Action: (thwart): Remove 3 threat from a scheme. Heal a total of 3 damage from among Jessica Jones and Luke Cage.

jj.name: * Second Chance
jj.text: Victory 0. When Defeated: Each player may shuffle all of their identity-specific cards from their discard pile into their deck.

jj.name: * Defend Our City
jj.text: [star] Hinder 1[per_hero]. Prerequisite ([[Defender]]). Victory 0. When Defeated: Each player may search their deck and discard pile for a Team-Up card and add it to their hand. Until the end of the phase, reduce the cost to play each Team-Up card by 1.

jj.name: Work-Life Balance
jj.text: Give to the Jessica Jones player. As an additional cost to change forms, discard 1 card from your hand. Alter-Ego Action: Choose: • Remove an ally you control from the game → remove this card from the game. • Confuse your identity → discard this card.

jj.name: * Purple Man
jj.text: [star] Purple Man's SCH is equal to the highest SCH or THW among characters in play. His ATK is equal to the highest ATK among characters in play.

jj.name: Indomitable Will
jj.text: [star] Hinder 3[per_hero]. When Revealed: Place 2 pheromone counters on each Suggestion obligation in play. Forced Response: After a Suggestion obligation enters play, place 2 (additional) pheromone counters on it.

jj.name: Suggestion ([energy])
jj.text: Uses (3 pheromone counters). Forced Action: Exhaust this card and remove 1 pheromone counter from it → choose to either play a card that has a printed [energy] resource icon (paying its costs) or add 2 threat to the main scheme.

jj.name: Suggestion ([mental])
jj.text: Uses (3 pheromone counters). Forced Action: Exhaust this card and remove 1 pheromone counter from it → choose to either play a card that has a printed [mental] resource icon (paying its costs) or add 2 threat to the main scheme.

jj.name: Suggestion ([physical])
jj.text: Uses (3 pheromone counters). Forced Action: Exhaust this card and remove 1 pheromone counter from it → choose to either play a card that has a printed [physical] resource icon (paying its costs) or add 2 threat to the main scheme.

jj.name: Innate Aggression
jj.text: Starting. (You may add this card to your hand before drawing your starting hand.) Your hero gets +1 ATK.

jj.name: Shakedown
jj.text: Play under any player's control. Max 1 per player. Response: After you attack and exactly defeat a minion, exhaust this card → remove threat from a scheme equal to that minion's base SCH.

jj.name: Innate Perception
jj.text: Starting. (You may add this card to your hand before drawing your starting hand.) Your hero gets +1 THW.

jj.name: Innate Inspiration
jj.text: Starting. (You may add this card to your hand before drawing your starting hand.) Each ally you control gets +1 hit point.

jj.name: * Echo
jj.subtitle: Maya Lopez
jj.text: Reduce the amount of damage Echo takes from each enemy attack by your hero's DEF.

jj.name: * Lay Low
jj.text: Victory 0. When Defeated: Each player may change to alter-ego form. Heal damage from each alter-ego equal to its REC.

jj.name: Mitigated Threat
jj.text: Attach to a card. Attached card loses each [acceleration], [amplify], [crisis], and [hazard] icon. Forced Response: At the end of the round, each player may spend 1 resource of any type. If any player does not, discard this card.

luke_cage.name: * Luke Cage
luke_cage.text: Unbreakable Skin — Luke Cage can have any number of tough status cards. Attacks against Luke Cage lose piercing. Forced Response: After a tough status card is discarded from Luke Cage, he takes 1 unpreventable damage (ignoring tough).

luke_cage.name: * Luke Cage
luke_cage.text: Unbreakable Skin — Luke Cage can have any number of tough status cards. Attacks against Luke Cage lose piercing. Action: Search your deck and discard pile for the Burstein Process upgrade and add it to your hand. (Limit once per phase.)

luke_cage.name: * Jessica Jones
luke_cage.text: [star] Jessica Jones gets +1 THW for each tough status card on your identity (to a maximum of +4 THW).

luke_cage.name: Harlem's Hero
luke_cage.text: Hero Action: Give Luke Cage a tough status card. For each tough status card on Luke Cage, choose a character you control and ready it.

luke_cage.name: Knuckle Sandwich
luke_cage.text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 3 damage to an enemy. You may discard a tough status card from Luke Cage to return this event to your hand.

luke_cage.name: "Stand with Me!"
luke_cage.text: Hero Action (thwart): Give Luke Cage a tough status card. Remove 1 threat from a scheme for each tough status card on Luke Cage (to a maximum of 5).

luke_cage.name: "Sweet Christmas!"
luke_cage.text: [star] Reduce the cost to play this card by 1 for each tough status card on Luke Cage. Hero Action (attack): Deal 5 damage to the villain and each minion engaged with you.

luke_cage.name: * Fogwell's Gym
luke_cage.text: Response: After a tough status card is discarded from a [[Defender]] character, exhaust Fogwell's gym → ready that character.

luke_cage.name: * Burstein Process
luke_cage.text: Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust Burstein Process → give Luke Cage a tough status card (2 tough status cards instead if he has none).

luke_cage.name: Cruisin' for a Bruisin'
luke_cage.text: Attach to a minion. Max 1 per minion. Attacks against attached minion deal 2 additional damage and gain overkill. Response: After you play this card, engage attached minion.

luke_cage.name: Metal Bracer
luke_cage.text: Luke Cage gets retaliate 1. Hero Interrupt: When any amount of damage would be dealt to Luke Cage, exhaust Metal Bracer → reduce that damage by 1.

luke_cage.name: * Power Man
luke_cage.text: Hero Response: After a tough status card is discarded from Luke Cage, exhaust Power Man → draw a card.

luke_cage.name: * Iron Fist
luke_cage.subtitle: Danny Rand
luke_cage.text: Interrupt: When Iron Fist defends against an enemy attack, prevent damage from that attack equal to Iron Fist's ATK.

luke_cage.name: * Misty Knight
luke_cage.text:
Toughness.
[star] Misty Knight gets +2 ATK and +2 THW while she has a tough status card.

luke_cage.name: * Valkyrie
luke_cage.subtitle: Brunnhilde
luke_cage.text: Toughness. Interrupt: When another ally would be defeated, discard Valkyrie (from play) → instead heal that ally until they have 1 hit point remaining.

luke_cage.name: Take a Stand
luke_cage.text: Hero Response: After your hero defends, each ally you control gets +1 THW and +1 ATK until the end of the player phase.

luke_cage.name: Innovation
luke_cage.text: Max 1 per deck. Hero Response: After you spend this card, heal 1 damage from an ally you control.

luke_cage.name: The Power of Leadership
luke_cage.text: Max 2 per deck. Double the number of resources this card generates while paying for a Leadership (blue) card.

luke_cage.name: Defensive Formation
luke_cage.text: Uses (3 block counters). Action: Exhaust this card and remove 1 block counter from it → give a [[Defender]] ally a tough status card.

luke_cage.name: Righteous Purpose
luke_cage.text:
Play under any player's control. Max 1 per player.
Each character you control that has exactly 1 hit point remaining gets +2 THW and +2 ATK.

luke_cage.name: * Hulk
luke_cage.subtitle: Bruce Banner
luke_cage.text: Hulk gets +1 ATK for each rage counter here. Response: After the villain attacks you, place 1 rage counter here.

luke_cage.name: * She-Hulk
luke_cage.subtitle: Jennifer Walters
luke_cage.text: Toughness. Response: After She-Hulk enters play, give your identity a tough status card.

luke_cage.name: Dynamic Duo
luke_cage.text: Action: Search your deck and discard pile for a Team-Up card and an ally named by that card's Team-Up keyword. Add those cards to your hand. (Shuffle.)

luke_cage.name: Power Man and Iron Fist
luke_cage.text: Team-Up (Iron Fist and Luke Cage). Max 1 per deck. Hero Action (attack): Deal 2 damage to an enemy and give a tough status card to a character.

luke_cage.name: Unbreakable Bond
luke_cage.text: Team-Up (Jessica Jones and Luke Cage). Max 1 per deck. Hero Action: (thwart): Remove 3 threat from a scheme. Heal a total of 3 damage from among Jessica Jones and Luke Cage.

luke_cage.name: Energy
luke_cage.text: Max 1 per deck.

luke_cage.name: Genius
luke_cage.text: Max 1 per deck.

luke_cage.name: Strength
luke_cage.text: Max 1 per deck.

luke_cage.name: Internal Injury
luke_cage.text: Give to the Luke Cage player. Forced Response: After the player phase ends, take 3 unpreventable damage (ignoring tough status cards). Alter-Ego Response: After you recover, remove Internal Injury from the game.

luke_cage.name: * Cottonmouth
luke_cage.text:
[star] Forced Response: After Cottonmouth attacks, he attacks the same character 2 additional times. (Limit once per phase.) (Luke Cage's nemesis minion.)
[star] Boost: Deal this card to the Luke Cage player as a facedown encounter card.

luke_cage.name: Venomous Whispers
luke_cage.text:
Each [[Serpent Society]] minion cannot be attacked. When Defeated: The defeating player discards cards from the top of the encounter deck until a [[Serpent Society]] minion is discarded and reveals that minion.
[star] Boost: You are confused.

luke_cage.name: Augmented Jaws
luke_cage.text: Attach to Cottonmouth. Otherwise, attach to the villain. [star] Forced Interrupt: When attached enemy attacks a character, discard each tough status card from that character. Hero Action: Spend [mental] [mental] resources → discard this card.

luke_cage.name: * Asp
luke_cage.text:
[star] Forced Response: After Asp schemes against you, you are stunned.
[star] Boost: You are stunned.

luke_cage.name: * Sidewinder
luke_cage.text: Quickstrike. Forced Interrupt: When Sidewinder is attacked, discard the top card of the encounter deck. If the discarded card has a "Boost" ability, deal Sidewinder to the attacking player as a facedown encounter card.

luke_cage.name: Size Advantage
luke_cage.text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 3 damage to an enemy (6 damage instead if you have the [[Giant]] trait or more remaining hit points than that enemy).

luke_cage.name: Observe
luke_cage.text: Hero Action: The villain schemes. Give your hero a tough status card.

luke_cage.name: Toughen Up
luke_cage.text: Response: After you recover, if your remaining hit points are equal to or greater than your base hit points, exhaust Toughen Up → give your identity a tough status card.

luke_cage.name: Black Belt
luke_cage.text:
Play only if any player controls a [[Martial Artist]] card.
Attach to a friendly character. Max 1 per character.
Attached character gets +1 hit point and gains the [[Martial Artist]] trait.
